result:
Looking at the qlang documentation, I'll work through each task systematically.

M1: Filter active users with non-null email, extract emails in lowercase, sort
M2: Filter users with valid profiles and numeric ages, compute average rounded to 1 decimal
M3: Group users by country (case-insensitive), uppercase keys, count per country
M4: Filter open issues with "bug" label (case-insensitive), sort by priority desc/id asc, take 2 ids
M5: Count issues per assignee, null/missing → "unassigned"
M6: Collect all labels, lowercase, deduplicate, sort
M7: Extract dependencies, remove leading ^/~, return {name, version}, sort by name
M8: Sum qty*price for paid/shipped orders, round to 2 decimals
M9: Group non-cancelled orders by customer, sum per customer, top 2 by total desc/name asc
M10: Filter services with tls.enabled==true, return "host:port" strings sorted by service name
M11: Count ERROR lines per service
M12: Find WARN/ERROR lines with "timeout" in message, return distinct services
M13: Parse CSV, average salary per department (skip empty), round to integer
M14: Extract words from text, count, return top 3 by count desc/word asc

M1: filter ~(eq /active true) | filter ~(ne (at :email) null) | * /email | * lower | sort

M2: filter ~(has :profile) | * /profile | filter ~(has :age) | filter ~(ne /age null) | * /age | [sum count] | div /0 /1 | mul 10 | round | div 10

M3: filter ~(has :profile) | * /profile | filter ~(has :country) | filter ~(ne /country null) | * /country | * upper | groupBy * count

M4: filter ~(eq /state "open") | filter ~(/labels | any ~(eq (upper) "BUG")) | sort ~([(/priority | mul -1) /id]) | take 2 | * /id

M5: * (at /assignee | coalesce "unassigned") | keyword | groupBy * count

M6: * /labels | flat | * lower | distinct

M7: /dependencies | entries | * {:name (keyword /0) :version (/1 | if (startsWith "^") ~(drop 1) ~(if (startsWith "~") ~(drop 1) ~(/)))} | sort ~/name

M8: filter ~(if (eq /status "paid") ~(true) ~(eq /status "shipped")) | * /items | flat | * (mul /qty /price) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100

M9: filter ~(ne /status "cancelled") | groupBy /customer | entries | * {:customer (keyword /0) :total (/1 * /items | flat | * (mul /qty /price) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100)} | sort ~([(/total | mul -1) /customer]) | take 2

M10: /services | entries | filter ~(eq /1/tls/enabled true) | sort ~/0 | * ([/1/host (at /1/port | coalesce 80 | print)] | join ":")

M11: lines | * (split " ") | filter ~(eq /1 "ERROR") | * /2 | groupBy * count

M12: lines | * (split " ") | filter ~(if (eq /1 "WARN") ~(true) ~(if (eq /1 "ERROR") ~(true) ~(false))) | filter ~((drop 3 | join " " | lower | contains "timeout")) | * /2 | distinct

M13: lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter ~(ne /2 "") | groupBy /1 | entries | * {:dept (keyword /0) :avg (/1 * /2 | * (parseJson) | [(sum) (count)] | div /0 /1 | round)}

M14: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The dog sleeps; the fox runs. A fox is quick." | split " " | * (split ".") | flat | * (split ";") | flat | * (split ",") | flat | filter ~(ne / "") | * lower | groupBy * count | entries | * {:word (keyword /0) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /word]) | take 3
